table_title: Table 9.9.2.6.1: NAS security parameters from E-UTRA information element
columns: DL NAS COUNT value (short) (octet 2, bit 1 to 4)
rows: This field contains the 4 least significant bits of the binary representation of the downlink NAS COUNT value applicable when this information element is sent.
Bit 5 to 8 of octet 2 are spare and shall be coded as zero.
